name: AI Bug Report Analyzer and Prioritizer

parameters.content:
## AI Bug Report Analyzer & Prioritizer

**Setup:**
1. Connect OpenAI API, Google Sheets OAuth2, Telegram Bot credentials
2. Set spreadsheet ID for bug triage board
3. Set Telegram chat ID for critical alerts
4. POST to webhook: `{"description": "bug description", "reporter": "name", "environment": "prod", "steps": "1. Do X...", "expected": "Y should happen", "actual": "Z happened"}`

Analyzes bugs for severity/impact/category, suggests root cause and fix, triages to Sheets, and sends Telegram alert for critical issues.
